items.summary: Advance C13-CONFIG-SECRET-CUSTODY from planned with exact evidence
notes: The Binding foundation is present: the Tenant-owned Binding record carries canonical, unique (SecretRef, endpoint) custody facts, validates each SecretRef source against its exact TenantId, preserves or explicitly rotates those facts through the Binding mutation path, and restores the same record through Memory and SQLite storage. This is constituent data in the Binding codec, not a second durable custody record or mirror

The remaining authority work is to bind that complete Binding snapshot to the target-owned request and Tenant-issued permit used for cross-Actor mediated admission. Tenant issuance must compare it with the current canonical Binding in the Tenant transaction, and target consumption must authenticate the exact retained request and permit without a synchronous cross-Actor read or a copied Binding authority plane

The remaining provider work is a concrete credential-isolation adapter that accepts only authenticated permit/request evidence, rejects inactive, substituted, guest, cross-Tenant, SecretRef, consumer, and endpoint mismatches, and injects raw credential material directly into transport. Confirmed custody refusal must become a failed attempted Receipt, while unavailable or unknown provider outcomes remain indeterminate. Redirect/repoint behavior, restart/replay, raw-secret non-escape, and the deployed Cloudflare boundary still need behavioral evidence before this atom can be verified

items.summary: Advance C13-CONTENT-CUSTODY from planned with exact evidence
notes: The §8.4 ownership map now declares ContentRef-bearing fields and their retention owner in its existing artifacts/records/*.json rows. The records checker derives the live denominator from the registered TypeScript record shapes, including nested fields and concrete subclasses of abstract registered records, and rejects missing, stale, wrong, duplicate, or mis-owned declarations. The current registry has 30 ContentRef-bearing kinds: 24 durable records and 6 value records; value records name fields but correctly claim no independent durable retainer

This prerequisite does not implement custody. Every write path for the 24 declared durable kinds must register its exact referenced content in the owning Actor's transaction, every defined removal path must release it in that transaction, append-only records must retain it for their full durable lifetime, and collection must exclude content held by every declared owner

Closure still requires memory and SQLite behavior tests covering create, replace, rollback, restart, release, collection, nested definition and Environment references, inherited AttemptReceipt.result, and concurrent collection attempts. AC-CONTENT-001 remains limited to retention safety after an ownership edge exists and does not prove registration-on-naming

items.summary: Advance C13-FACET-DISPOSAL from implemented with exact evidence
notes: The W9 mediation pipeline releases provider and dynamic resolutions after each invocation, and the W5 executor behavior covers Turn completion, failure, cancellation, suspension, thrown execution, and authority loss; W9-owned cancellation and authority-loss selectors plus fresh mutation attribution must discriminate those disposal paths before verification

items.summary: Advance C13-OWNERSHIP-AUTHORITY-RECORDS from planned with exact evidence
notes: Creating, replacing, and deactivating a Binding now advances its path epoch in the same Tenant-local transaction, with memory and SQLite success, idempotence, and rollback coverage; the record registry also declares Binding, Grant, and ScopeEpoch only in the Tenant authority store

The remaining evidence must discriminate against an undeclared Workspace or Run store persisting a canonical or mirrored Binding, Grant, or ScopeEpoch; rejecting a duplicate registry row does not detect an implementation that dual-writes without registering the second plane

items.summary: Advance C13-OWNERSHIP-SINGLE-OWNER from planned with exact evidence
notes: The importable record-ownership validator and its all-kind adversary prove that the declared registry cannot name a second owner for a durable kind, and the authority-state contract proves one derived cache can be dropped and rebuilt
Rule 2 still needs implementation-linked evidence for the constrained dedicated-Run index and for every other Actor retaining identifiers or rebuildable indexes rather than replayable canonical state
Rule 3 still needs a complete cache inventory proving every cache is derived, versioned, rebuildable, and treats a miss as ordinary; one authority-cache loss case is not the universal claim

Rule 4 still needs a discriminator for undeclared dual writes and evidence that cross-Actor reads use RPC or explicitly versioned snapshots; a unique registry declaration alone cannot prove either absence

items.summary: Advance C13-PLACEMENT-AUTHORED-BACKING from planned with exact evidence
notes: The declaration half is built and discrimination-tested. PlacementPolicy carries `backings` (src/definition/placement.ts#AuthoredCodeBackingPolicy), a partial map from the closed §4.7 consumer set to an opaque AuthoredCodeBackingId, read through PlacementPolicy.backingFor(consumer, profileDefault); an unmapped consumer takes the substrate profile's declared default and never another offered backing. test/definition/authored-code-backing.test.ts covers it under this atom's id, and four mutations — ignoring the declaration, sending an unmapped consumer to a declared backing, dropping the mapping on encode, and opening the consumer set — each break a cited test.

Worker Loader is the only §4.7 backing currently implemented by the Cloudflare package. It loads the isolate with `globalOutbound: null`, `disallow_importable_env`, and an `env` holding one entrypoint stub per delegated Binding and nothing else, all three exercised against real workerd in the cloudflare lane.

The former dispatch-namespace adapter was removed because it could not establish the abstract AuthoredCodeBacking contract it claimed: outbound posture is a property of the binding's deployed outbound Worker, not of `DispatchNamespace.get()`. Restoring the §10.2 dispatch backing requires a configured deny-all outbound Worker, the exact deployed binding, and a real substrate test proving both `fetch` and `connect` are unavailable while passed Binding capabilities remain callable.

C13-PLACEMENT-DYNAMIC-NO-EGRESS remains an explicit prerequisite. Verification also requires ownership-correct integration evidence connecting the W4 declaration to every W8 backing the profile actually offers; Worker Loader evidence cannot stand in for an unimplemented dispatch backing.

items.summary: Advance C13-PLACEMENT-DYNAMIC-NO-EGRESS from planned with exact evidence
notes: The rule is enforced by domain construction at the substrate (SPEC §1.5: policy code inside the domain is not a security boundary); W4's definition plane can declare only the dynamic mode and cannot establish the network posture of a W8 backing

No substrate-neutral interface, nominal token, or local reference can prove zero ambient egress. Verification requires ownership-correct integration between the W4 placement decision and every concrete backing the selected profile offers, together with evidence from each backing's real enforcement boundary

For Worker Loader, adversarial code running in the real substrate must fail both global fetch and connect while an explicitly passed Binding remains callable. A dispatch-namespace backing additionally requires the exact deployed namespace and deny-all outbound Worker configuration; local fakes do not satisfy either obligation

items.summary: Advance C13-POLICY-EPOCH-RECHECK from implemented with exact evidence
notes: The current-epoch check this rule states is the authority-admission comparison of SPEC 3.4 rule 7, and src/definition holds no epoch state to compare: evaluatePolicy decides only whether an effect is mediated at all. Discriminating evidence has to come from the authority admission path, so this fragment carries the tier decision and states the rest as outstanding rather than verifying the rule on plan-assembly kind rechecks, which bear on no epoch.

items.summary: Advance C13-RUN-TREE-CONFLICT-EXPLICIT from planned with exact evidence
notes: Conflict detection remains unimplemented over the opaque tree checkpoint digest. Closure requires one ContentStore-backed tree codec and diff path whose decoded bytes prove each ContentRef, rather than a test-only snapshot map
The effective tree policy must be loaded by the exact PolicySet id, revision, and digest in commit.pins.effectivePolicy; an unbound RunMergePort policy projection is not sufficient evidence

The merge-resolution control evidence must prove that its authenticated caller invoked the administer-impact Operation whose successful Receipt proposal digest binds these exact path choices; generic system-control writer evidence alone is insufficient

items.summary: Advance C13-TURN-ADMISSION-HANDLE from planned with exact evidence
notes: GatewayTurnInvocationPort currently returns only Operation output, so no concrete mediated pipeline path can return a verified InvocationId or child RunRef in the model tool position; a fake TurnInvocationPort returning a preconstructed handle would not prove this rule

SpawnReservation alone does not prove successful admission. Closure requires the exact EffectAttempt named by the AttemptReceipt, the succeeded Receipt and its hashed result bytes, and an exact canonical child-RunRef-only payload to be validated before constructing the handle; extra child-output fields must be rejected

The public-interface test must traverse the concrete mediated gateway and prove unchanged admission plus linked Receipt and audit evidence, then observe only the verified admission identity at the executor boundary

items.summary: Advance C13-VIEW-APPROVAL-PROVENANCE from planned with exact evidence
notes: §6.3 now defines every missing term by composition: a decision View is discriminated by the presence of a new optional `intentDigest` field; provenance uses a new optional `marks: readonly ViewMark[]` field whose `path` reuses the existing FieldMapping/PayloadMapping JSON Pointer vocabulary (§6.2) rather than inventing pointer syntax; and platform voice is defined functionally — any rendered position a viewer would attribute to the platform rather than to the marked value's own source

The durable record and replay prerequisite is implemented: View codec major 2 and ViewDelta documents omit provenance fields on ordinary Views, require both intentDigest and marks on decision Views, reject inconsistent provenance shapes and marks outside the exact body, and preserve decision provenance through memory snapshot restore and file-backed SQLite reopen

The rendering conjunct has no production enforcement point today: Facet Surface.render and ProfileRuntimeEffectsPort.render return generic FacetData, and no production Surface-to-View presenter constructs or validates a View. A codec-only change could preserve marks yet still render marked input as a headline, button label, or unattributed host prose, so it cannot verify this atom

Closing the atom still requires one canonical production presentation path that constructs a decision View from the exact prepared intent, proves every non-host body value is marked with its actual TrustTier, and constrains marked values to data presentation rather than platform voice; no current Surface renderer or ProfileRuntimeEffectsPort performs that composition

items.summary: Advance P11-ENVIRONMENT-NO-AMBIENT-EGRESS from planned with exact evidence
notes: No Session egress plane exists in the runtime: environments model files, snapshots, and exposures but no EgressGrant or destination Binding, so the positive half (a send reaches exactly its named Binding's destination and an unbound destination refuses) has no source symbol; it is currently claimed only formally (AC-ENVIRONMENT-001, session_egress_is_explicitly_bound / unbound_send_is_refused) with NC-ENVIRONMENT-LIFECYCLE deferring the runtime

The adversarial half — code inside the Session cannot open a connection the platform did not pass — is a substrate property (globalOutbound: null, cf. the Slate loader) and needs either an isolate-backed Session provider with a local negative test or a new W8 consent gate and ACQ-LIVE scenario; no local emulation may substitute

Checked at HEAD: the only globalOutbound assertion in the tree is packages/agent-core-cloudflare/test/hosting.test.ts "forces one-time Dynamic Worker load with null outbound and only passed Bindings", which drives DynamicWorkerLoaderAdapter against FakeWorkerLoader and so records the argument the adapter passes, never a refused connection; being local emulation it is exactly what this atom excludes, and it is cited by no requirement
